jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Hardware
jobs.description:
About Gridware
Gridware is a San Francisco-based technology company dedicated to protecting and enhancing the electrical grid. We pioneered a groundbreaking new class of grid management called active grid response (AGR), focused on monitoring the electrical, physical, and environmental aspects of the grid that affect reliability and safety. Gridware’s advanced Active Grid Response platform uses high-precision sensors to detect potential issues early, enabling proactive maintenance and fault mitigation. This comprehensive approach helps improve safety, reduce outages, and ensure the grid operates efficiently. The company is backed by climate-tech and Silicon Valley investors. For more information, please visit www.Gridware.io.


Role Description
As a Technical Program Manager at Gridware, you’ll drive complex, multi-disciplinary projects across firmware, hardware, and supporting software systems. You’ll partner with engineers and stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage schedules, and deliver critical programs on time. You should be equally comfortable discussing system trade-offs with engineers as you are presenting recommendations to executives. This role sits at the intersection of firmware, hardware, and embedded systems with visibility into mobile, web, backend, and data platforms that integrate with our devices.

What You'll Do 
- Lead end-to-end program execution across firmware and hardware development, ensuring alignment from concept through deployment.

- Define project scope, milestones, resources, and success criteria for highly cross-functional initiatives.

- Partner closely with engineering leads to manage risks, unblock dependencies, and balance technical trade-offs.

- Build and maintain tools, processes, and dashboards that improve program visibility and engineering productivity.

- Communicate schedules, priorities, and status updates clearly to engineers, leadership, and cross-functional partners.
What We’re Looking For
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- 5+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering, or related infrastructure/embedded systems roles (firmware/hardware emphasis strongly preferred).

- Proven ability to deliver in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and multiple stakeholders.

- Familiarity with the hardware development lifecycles (EVT/DVT/etc), phase gates and working with CMs

- Strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical complexity into clear, actionable plans.
Bonus Skills
- Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

- Experience scaling engineering organizations and building cross-functional alignment.

- Background in product development for IoT, embedded systems, or large-scale hardware/software deployments.

- Experience leading projects that improved application performance, scalability, or fleet-wide reliability.
This describes the ideal candidate; many of us have picked up this expertise along the way. Even if you meet only part of this list, we encourage you to apply!
 
Gridware Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
Benefits
Health, Dental & Vision (Gold and Platinum with some providers plans fully covered) 
Paid parental leave 
Alternating day off (every other Monday)
“Off the Grid”, a two week per year paid break for all employees. 
Commuter allowance 
Company-paid training

jobs.description:
About Gridware
Gridware is a San Francisco-based technology company dedicated to protecting and enhancing the electrical grid. We pioneered a groundbreaking new class of grid management called active grid response (AGR), focused on monitoring the electrical, physical, and environmental aspects of the grid that affect reliability and safety. Gridware’s advanced Active Grid Response platform uses high-precision sensors to detect potential issues early, enabling proactive maintenance and fault mitigation. About the Role
As a Staff Hardware Product Manager, you will lead the development of our hardware product portfolio. This is a critical, foundational role - with broad responsibility for defining, building, and launching innovative hardware solutions that enable our mission.
 
You will work cross-functionally with engineering, operations, manufacturing partners, and marketing teams to translate customer needs into robust hardware products, drive product strategy and roadmaps, and ensure successful delivery from concept through production.

Responsibilities 
- Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for Gridware’s hardware products, from identifying customer and business problems through product definition, development, launch, and ongoing iteration.

- Develop and drive hardware product strategy and roadmaps aligned with company priorities, customer needs, and long-term product vision.

- Gather and synthesize customer, market, and field insights to identify the highest-impact problems to solve and inform product priorities.

- Translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, cost, reliability, and time to market.

- Partner closely with hardware, firmware, and software engineering to evaluate solutions and make informed product tradeoffs.

- Collaborate with manufacturing, supply chain, reliability, and quality teams to successfully launch, scale, and improve products in the field.

- Drive complex cross-functional initiatives, bringing clarity to priorities, decisions, dependencies, risks, and timelines.

- Define product success metrics and use customer and field feedback to inform future product decisions and revisions.
Required Skills
- 7+ years of Product experience, or 4+ years of Product experience combined with significant prior hardware engineering experience.

- Experience owning hardware products across the full lifecycle, from customer discovery and product definition through development, validation, launch, and post-launch iteration.

- Strong product judgment, with a track record of identifying customer and business problems, defining requirements, prioritizing tradeoffs, and translating strategy into an actionable roadmap.

- Strong understanding of hardware product development and the ability to partner effectively with electrical, mechanical, firmware, software, manufacturing, and reliability teams.

- Strong project management skills, with experience driving complex, cross-functional initiatives from definition through execution.

- Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and bringing structure to problems that may not have a clear path forward.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across technical and non-technical teams without direct authority.

- Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and a bias toward action.
Bonus Skills
- Experience working with contract manufacturers and hardware supply chains is a plus.

- Experience with cloud-connected hardware and modern software systems
This describes the ideal candidate; many of us have picked up this expertise along the way. Even if you meet only part of this list, we encourage you to apply!

Health, Dental & Vision (Gold and Platinum with some providers plans fully covered)
